Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri Oct 3 15:47:40 2025 +0000

    Bug 1970846 - update bouncer aliases now that ESR 128 is EOL. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D267434

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
index aa67b11afde..3314c6d3ad2 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
@@ -46,15 +46,14 @@ tasks:
                     thunderbird-latest: installer
                     thunderbird-msi-latest-ssl: msi
                     thunderbird-msix-latest-ssl: msix
-                esr128:
-                    # when there is one ESR branch both sets of aliases work
+                esr140:
+                    # when there is one ESR branch both sets of aliases are set for that branch
                     # when there are two ESR branches ...
                     # ... these always point to the older branch
                     thunderbird-esr-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
                     thunderbird-esr-latest: installer
                     thunderbird-esr-msi-latest-ssl: msi
                     thunderbird-esr-msix-latest-ssl: msix
-                esr140:
                     # ... these point to the newer branch
                     thunderbird-esr-next-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
                     thunderbird-esr-next-latest: installer
title: Bug 1970846 - update bouncer aliases now that ESR 128 is EOL. r=dandarnell
